correctness.rationale: For the repaired size enumerator, testing against a third edge gives the single same-column pair (p,q), exactly five offset-one and four offset-two types, and no more distant conflicts. Therefore the last two masks suffice, with (0,0) padding and a final mask in {0,1}. The repair groups the 17 state equations into five by row reflection and identical successor classes; both the list of states and the right sides match the original transfer. The cleared polynomial identities in the repair agree with the exact integer certificate and have unique formal solution since every recursive term has a factor t and D(0,z)=1. Independent replay in /workspace/branches/ba3e0b65-af74-42c3-bc08-198803ecc6d2/literal_edge_open_check.py and symbolic_transfer_check.py built conflicts from actual third edges, matched 74,898 exhaustive small subsets through n=6, and verified the exact symbolic resolvent, not merely a finite prefix. The z=1 numerator is 2t+7t²+8t³+t⁴, so the order-four recurrence starts at n=5. The original optimum and classification were not rejected as false: the original potential bound telescopes; at equality a singleton-rung branch can only finish, a same-row successive single rail stalls, and a row-double is followed by zero, after which either the string finishes or the opposite row must start. This gives its indicated triples and boundaries (right piece opposite to the preceding piece). The original script checks arcs from 17 states, not 17 arcs. The repaired Finding does not rely on that extremal argument. Frozen scripts were inspected, not executed.
